title: 16.36. Parittattika, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Parittaṁ hetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca namahaggato nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā terasa, ārammaṇe nava …pe… aññamaññe ekādasa …pe… avigate terasa.
Parittaṁ nahetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naparitto nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cuddasa, ārammaṇe cuddasa, adhipatiyā nava …pe… avigate cuddasa.
